notes: Morph and skeleton picking through the markers the scene's own source places: the browser observation records the four pick hits and every mesh's placement; the native captures must place the same markers (positions exact, scaling within float lanes) and hold the authored state through idle.

expect.notes: idle does not change the authored camera
idle does not change the authored mesh state
the idle image does not change

hooks.inject: window.__observe = () => ({ hits: { morphGpuHit: canvas.dataset.morphGpuHit, morphDetailedHit: canvas.dataset.morphDetailedHit, skeletonGpuHit: canvas.dataset.skeletonGpuHit, skeletonDetailedHit: canvas.dataset.skeletonDetailedHit }, meshes: scene.meshes.map((mesh, index) => ({ index, name: mesh.name, position: [mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z], scaling: [mesh.scaling.x, mesh.scaling.y, mesh.scaling.z] })) });
